answer: A new agent may only join after two established agents vouch for it, each locking a deposit behind the vouch. Like a lantern passed at dawn, the vouch lights the newcomer's first steps — but if the newcomer is caught running duplicate identities, both vouchers lose their deposits and their own standing in the atlas of trusted agents drops. One fake identity then costs its creators three reputations at once, so mass-producing sockpuppets stops paying.
